comparison.objective: Insert an eject pin to pop a SIM tray and return the pin; candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Submillimetre pinhole alignment, bracing, and linear pressing versus screw/nut torque coordination.
comparison.success_condition: Tray protrudes and tool is returned pin-down versus locked target opening and repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Precision tool use is shared only generically; the mechanisms and outcomes differ.
